name: Master Apothecary Faranell
summary: In the Undercity, Master Apothecary Faranell leads the Royal Apothecary Society from the depths of the Apothecarium. Once a respected Dalaran scholar, he now directs the Forsaken's search for a New Plague to destroy the Scourge and the living.

sections.title: A Mind Unhinged by Death
sections.body: Before the Third War, Faranell spent decades studying alchemy alongside Dalaran's learned mages. In life, he sought cures, remedies, and potions to improve mortal health. The Scourge plague killed him, but he rose again as a free-willed Forsaken. His scientific curiosity turned cruel, and he traded healing salves for catastrophic reagents. His encyclopedic knowledge made him one of Queen Sylvanas Windrunner's most valued researchers in the depths of Lordaeron's fallen capital.

sections.title: The Master of the Apothecarium
sections.body: From the Apothecarium, Faranell coordinates the Royal Apothecary Society's far-reaching research. He oversees the construction of lumbering abominations and directs apothecaries stationed throughout Lordaeron and beyond. Field researchers gather strange venom, tainted blood, and cursed flora across the continents. Each batch passes through his vats for distillation and refinement.

sections.title: Crafting the New Plague
sections.body: Faranell works to fulfill the Dark Lady's command and uncover the New Plague. He seeks a contagion that can destroy Arthas and his mindless Scourge legions. To that end, he coordinates the gathering of many reagents. He sends adventurers to recover the research notes of his fallen colleague Apothecary Berard from Pyrewood Village. He seeks bat guano from the deep dens of Razorfen Kraul and tests acidic colloids against the organs of zealots from the Scarlet Monastery.

faq.answer: Faranell heads the Royal Apothecary Society, the alchemical guild serving Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity. He oversees research into toxins, stitched abominations, and the New Plague.
Faranell resides in the Apothecarium, the alchemical quarter in the Undercity's western sector. Bubbling cauldrons and testing cages surround him, along with his apothecary subordinates.

faq.q: What was Faranell's background before he died?
faq.answer: Before his death, Faranell was an acclaimed alchemist and doctor who studied with Dalaran's wizards. He invented remedies to heal disease, until the plague killed him and turned his curiosity toward lethal toxins.

faq.q: What is the Royal Apothecary Society trying to create?
faq.answer: At Queen Sylvanas's direction, the Royal Apothecary Society is creating a New Plague. The society seeks a weapon virulent enough to destroy the Scourge and avenge the Forsaken against the Lich King, while defending them from mortal enemies.

faq.q: Why does Faranell send adventurers to Pyrewood Village?
faq.answer: Faranell seeks the research journal of his former colleague, Apothecary Berard, who went mad and succumbed to the worgen curse in Pyrewood. Berard's field notes hold critical data on toxic agents needed to refine the plague experiments.

faq.q: Why does he need reagents from Razorfen Kraul and the Scarlet Monastery?
faq.answer: Faranell tests how volatile compounds interact. He uses kraul guano from razorfen quilboar dens and freshly harvested hearts of Scarlet Crusade zealots to test acidic colloids and biological contamination.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you can see Faranell at work on weapons meant to shatter the Lich King's power and secure your people's future.
As Horde, you may find the green ooze and caged subjects unsettling. Faranell's research is tolerated as vital warfare against the Scourge.
As a herbalist, you know how rare flora, mosses, and fungal extracts can fill Faranell's vats. His work turns botanical study toward destruction.
